recommended_project_framing: Objective-level optimization improves reconstruction versus the baseline. Across checkpoints, ResNet34 is the best practical trade-off because it gives the strongest embedding alignment and best mean MSE among complete variants, while ResNet18 remains fast and numerically strong on SSIM/PSNR but weaker for class-faithful semantic inversion. ResNet50/ResNet101 are useful deep-model comparisons but do not dominate all metrics, and ResNet152 evidence is partial.
